title: Chief Financial Officer
message:
Randy, I wrote in August and left it vague, which is probably why you did not reply. Let me be specific instead.

PDM runs offshore tooling alongside domestic production. When a mold comes from an overseas builder the quote is usually in dollars, but the builder is not, and the price you are given already carries their conversion and their cushion for it moving.

I work FX and cross border payments at Monex USA, and before this I ran finance across the US, Brazil and Mexico.

Do you pay any of those tooling or component suppliers in their own currency, or is it all dollars?

Marcel

title: Chief Financial Officer
message:
Matt, we connected a while back and I never followed up, so here I am doing it late.

PURIS grows and processes in North America, which takes the import side off the table. But pea protein is a global ingredient market and the European competition prices in euros, so if any of your volume ships outside the US the currency sits on the receivable rather than the payable.

I work FX and cross border payments at Monex USA, and before this I ran finance across the US, Brazil and Mexico.

Is export a big enough share at PURIS for that to be worth a look?

Marcel
